name: @slop-ai/discovery
description: SLOP bridge and discovery primitives. Use `@slop-ai/discovery/service` for connection orchestration and `@slop-ai/discovery/tools` for host tool helpers.

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts src/service.ts src/tools.ts src/anthropic-agent-sdk.ts src/context.ts src/cli.ts --outdir dist --format esm --target node --external '@slop-ai/consumer' --external '@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk' --external '@modelcontextprotocol/sdk' --external 'zod' --external 'ws' && bunx tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist
scripts.build:bundle: bun build src/cli.ts --outfile dist/cli.bundle.js --format esm --target node
